messages.subject: Free Entry – Big Data Analytics World Championships 2017
messages.subject_clean: Free Entry – Big Data Analytics World Championships 2017
messages.body_plain:
Hi Friends,

We're hosting the 3rd TEXATA Big Data Analytics World Championships (www.texata.com <http://www.texata.com/>) a fun, educational and challenging online global competition for professionals and university students looking to build their real-world skills in Big Data, Data Science, Machine Learning and Business Analytics. Two online rounds (4 hours each) and Live Top 12 World Finals in Austin Texas.  Round 1 Online starts on 30th September 2017 (5 weeks’ time).

Free Entry Code

Participants can use the complimentary free entry code – TEXAS17 ($0, normally $30) and register at www.texata.com. <http://www.texata.com./>  Feel free to share with any interested friends.

Best of luck!

John R Persico

Chief Organizer

TEXATA 2017

Big Data Analytics World Championships

Two Online Rounds. Live Finals in Austin TX.
